plot: At sunset little cousin Luna arrives to stay, grabs Max's ball and his window spot while everyone fusses over her; Max's big show-off jump lands him in the laundry basket, he sulks behind the sofa and finds Luna there, homesick, who copied and took his things because he is her brave hero; Max shares his spot and ball, and Grandma puts him in charge of Luna at the park tomorrow.

beats.say: Ooh! A red ball! Mine, mine, mine!
Hey! That's MY ball! Who are you, tiny fluffball?
Why does this kitten want everything that's mine?
It's sunset in Grandma's living room. The visitor is finally here.
Max, dear, this is Luna. Your little cousin from the city.
She's staying for a few days. Be a good big cousin.
Are you THE Max? The real, real Max? Wow!
Yes, I'm the real Max. And that is my real ball.
Max swishes his tail. Luna swishes her tiny tail too. Swish.
Why are you doing that? Stop copying my tail!
Why are you doing that? Stop copying my tail!
Who's this? A baby cat? She's so tiny! So cute!
Dog runs right past Max. He doesn't even say hi.
Hello, tiny one! Want to see me roll over? Look!
Luna giggles. Dog rolls again. And again. Everybody loves Luna.
And I have a welcome gift for our little Luna!
A gift? Grandma didn't give me a gift today.
Luna opens the purple gift. It's a soft little bell. Jingle!
Then Luna curls up in Max's favorite spot. By the warm window.
That's my sunset spot! Nobody sits there but me!
Share a little, Max. She's far from home tonight.
First my ball. Then my spot. Next it'll be my Grandma!
If this goes on, everyone will forget all about me.
I need to show them who the best cat is. Watch this!
Max climbs the sofa for his biggest, highest jump ever.
Everybody look! The amazing Max! Three, two, one... jump!
Max flies through the air... and lands in the laundry basket. Thump!
Socks on his head. A sock on his tail. Everyone laughs.
The amazing Max! I want to jump in the basket too!
It's not funny! I'm not a clown. I'm the big cousin!
Max climbs out of the basket. He hides behind the sofa, alone.
Nobody needs me now. They have a new, cute, tiny cat.
It gets dark outside. Then Max hears a small sound. Sniff. Sniff.
Who's there? Dog, is that you? Are you eating my snacks?
It's Luna. She is behind the sofa too, hugging the red ball.
I miss my mom. I never slept away from home before.
Oh. You're not happy here? But everybody loves you!
It's dark and new. And bedtime is soon. I'm scared, Max.
Bedtime is soon. And my little cousin is too scared to sleep.
Wait. Why did you take my ball? You have a new bell.
Because your ball smells like you. Mom says you're the bravest cat.
So I wanted to be just like you.
That's why I copy your tail, your jump, everything you do.
You copied me because I'm your hero? Me, the basket cat?
You're the best basket cat in the whole world.
Max laughs a little. Then he sits down close to Luna.
Want to know a secret? I get scared of the dark too.
You do? But you're THE Max! The bravest cat!
Brave doesn't mean not scared. It means you hold a friend's paw.
Max holds out his paw. Luna puts her tiny paw on top.
Come on. I'll show you the best spot for watching the moon.
The two cats walk to the warm window. Max first. Luna after.
This is my spot. But it's big enough for two cats.
And this is your ball. You can have it back now.
Keep it tonight. It smells like a brave cat, remember?
Aww. Can I squeeze in too? I'm only a little bit big.
Sorry, Dog. Window spot is cats only. You get the rug!
Two cats in one spot. Now that is a happy house.
Luna falls asleep, purring. Max stays awake to watch her.
Sharing my spot didn't make me smaller.
It just made room for one more friend. A tiny one.
Tomorrow we go to the park. Max, you'll look after Luna.
Me? In charge of a kitten? At the big, busy park? Gulp.

long.title: Max Has to Share EVERYTHING?! New Kitten Luna 😾🐱
long.description:
"First my ball, then my spot. Does anyone even see me?" 🐱
Little cousin Luna comes to stay, and suddenly everyone loves her and she takes everything that is Max's. Then, behind the sofa, Max finds out why. Max the Curious Cat, Ep 15.
